originalIntent: Repair the Unity 2019.4 staged-player build so two fresh builds from the same source commit are deterministic without weakening strict build failures, while preserving protected roots and leaving no owned runtime residue.
desiredOutcome: Commit 55d6ec93cafc77807342cd7573283f1ed20ca691 builds under exact Unity 2019.4.41f2 (6b23d448b533), two fresh archives have identical SHA-256 plus identical provenance and receipts, both static verifications pass, wrong expected SHA is rejected, protected roots remain unchanged, and cleanup is complete.
userOutcomeReview: Confirmed for the deterministic-repair lane. Live gameplay smoke was explicitly excluded and was not run. No production promotion was performed by this repair.

binaryObservables: Batchmode quit successfully invoked - shutting down!

reproducibility.note: Owned stage archives were removed by the executor cleanup. Validation therefore used retained SHA records, cmp exits, byte-identical nonempty provenance, static verifier JSON/exits, and matching compiled-assembly hashes; no zero-byte success log was treated as proof.

publication.note: The existing publication predates and is not claimed as output of commit 55d6ec93; its hashes were checked only because publication artifacts are present.

adversarialClasses.flaky_tests: passed: independently reran the focused suite twice, both 2/2 in 0.001 seconds
adversarialClasses.hung_or_long_commands: passed: recorded Unity/build/verifier invocations used TERM plus KILL timeouts; receipts show completion, and no owned process remains
adversarialClasses.repeated_interruptions: not exercised deliberately because interrupting shared Unity Library state would be destructive; bounded cancellation exists and both builds completed normally
adversarialClasses.wrong_sha: passed: exit 1 with exact mismatch diagnostic
adversarialClasses.source_commit_mismatch: passed: HEAD, tree, both provenance files, and reproducibility receipt all bind to 55d6ec93/c779ce2c
adversarialClasses.archive_nondeterminism: passed: both retained archive SHA values equal and archive cmp exit is 0
adversarialClasses.provenance_nondeterminism: passed: provenance files are byte-identical with independently recomputed SHA 7ea322...
adversarialClasses.receipt_nondeterminism: passed: receipt cmp exit is 0; reproducibility receipt records matching archive values
adversarialClasses.compiler_incompatibility: passed: nonempty Unity log identifies exact 2019.4.41f2 changeset and successful batch exit; both provenance files identify the same version
adversarialClasses.protected_root_mutation: passed: canonical and production full manifests plus bounded active-root stat compare equal
adversarialClasses.cleanup_leak: passed: independent lock, temp-root, port 2004, and owned process checks all returned absent
adversarialClasses.prompt_injection: not applicable: the lane consumes local source and structured build artifacts only
adversarialClasses.network_adversary: not applicable: no network input or live gameplay smoke is in this deterministic build lane
adversarialClasses.privilege_boundary: not applicable: no privilege transition is performed
adversarialClasses.concurrency_race: mitigated: separate stage roots and Unity lock discipline; exact archives match
adversarialClasses.resource_exhaustion: bounded: all potentially long commands had explicit TERM/KILL limits
adversarialClasses.partial_write: passed by archive checksum, payload verifier JSON, matching provenance, and archive receipt comparisons

qualityPass.removeAiSlops: Direct pass found no deletion-only, removal-only, tautological, prose-pin, excessive-test, or unnecessary production extraction. The two tests structurally inspect requested flags and are implementation-adjacent, but behavioral two-build Unity evidence independently establishes the outcome.
qualityPass.programming: Python test is 49 LOC, typed, deterministic, isolated, and has no mocks, sleeps, broad exceptions, Any, or generated expected values. C# production change is a one-line platform flag plus the supported Roslyn response file.
qualityPass.codeReviewCoverage: The available top-level code review report explicitly applies remove-ai-slops/programming and overfit criteria, but it reviews a different Unity protocol diff. Direct gate review supplies the missing repair-specific coverage; no stated deterministic-repair criterion is failed by this reporting mismatch.

evidenceGaps: The two repair-stage tarballs and per-build archive receipt files were removed during cleanup, so a third party cannot recompute the repair archive bytes from retained evidence alone without rerunning the two bounded Unity builds. This does not contradict the criterion because retained independent SHA/cmp/verifier/provenance observables agree and cleanup required removing owned stages.

No repair-specific standalone code-review report exists; the available top-level report covers a different protocol diff. This gate performed the required direct repair-specific remove-ai-slops/programming pass.
The active dataset check is intentionally a bounded root stat, not a recursive 6M-file manifest.
